proposal.title: Convert SSG General Ledger — CP/M edition to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: SSG General Ledger — CP/M edition
before.description: SSG General Ledger for Aurelia and Aurelia+ uses a native Z80 AION C implementation and the shared ROM TUI; its Aurelia release is on 6 June 1978. SSG owns and licenses the application and maintains specialist support. The package covers General Ledger, not a five-module accounting suite. Selected ledger balances and period totals can be exported to Abacus through a reconciled, versioned disk file. AION engineering sponsorship and Logix distribution confer no application ownership.

specification.description: SSG owns and licenses General Ledger.
Defines the CP/M implementation, ledger functions, platform support and delivery contents.
Defines independent SSG ownership and the development, distribution and training relationship.
